description: p4-native's hooks. register.ts is the hooks module, whose functions run inside Claude Code, and it is the whole plugin: no command hook runs and no process starts at a session's start. At session.start it asks the engine what this host is, the surfaces the session draws on, the Claude Code version and the tools that answer, and writes the capability map to .claude/p4/native/host.json under the session's id, without the session waiting for it. It reads the map again at the first turn of the main conversation and after the session's id changed. probes.ts holds the watched conditions, one probe for each decision the platform blocked. The module reads them when the Claude Code version kept in .claude/p4/native/probes.json for this kind of host is not this session's, at the first turn and at that turn's end, and on request, and never at a start. An answer that changed is a notice the next prompt carries to the model once. It registers the slash command /native and the tool native, whose map, probes and probe each print what the module read. Two options of the plugin's userConfig, off by default, each make one call of Claude Code's own: push calls the PushNotification tool at the end of a turn of a session ezexe is at, and status pins a line that names the host by $.ui.status.
